scientific_integrity: A fully specified finite CW quotient, exact integral chain reductions, and a standalone reproducer. All certification in this package is self-review; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to Hom(C5,K5) and its ordinary geometric quotient by input-position D5. The cohomology ring and equivariant Stiefel homeomorphism are not computed; possible unindexed earlier equivalent results have not been excluded.
title: Integral homology of the dihedral quotient of \(\operatorname{Hom}(C_5,K_5)\)
